QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_1

question.text: Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (open-ended Cat III) ended its Q2 on 30-September. By which date must the Investment Manager submit the quarterly activity report to SEBI on the Intermediary Portal, as per Regulation 28 / SEBI circular?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI Circular dated 07-April-2021 (Regulatory Reporting by AIFs) mandates that every AIF file its quarterly activity report within 10 CALENDAR days from the end of each quarter. For Q2 ending 30-September, the T+10 deadline falls on 10-October. All Cat III AIFs must additionally file a separate leverage report on the same T+10 timeline. The Trap: 07-Oct is a T+7 invention. 30-Oct is the 30-day CTR-style window. 29-Nov (60 days) is the window for the quarterly investor report on risks/portfolio (not the SEBI filing). Mixing the SEBI T+10 with the investor T+60 is the classic trap. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B (Cat III Distributor) tests the investor-facing T+60 quarterly report window. XIX-C (All-Cat Manager) tests both. XIX-D (Cat I/II Manager) has the same SEBI T+10 but no leverage supplementary report. Manager's Pro-Tip: Block 10-Oct / 10-Jan / 10-Apr / 10-Jul on the ops calendar as immovable SEBI filing days. Build the leverage schedule (cash borrow + derivative gross notional) and the activity report in parallel — both drop into the SEBI Intermediary Portal the same day.
